"; `$\ = "<O>"; print "x"` -> "x<O>" unchanged; `say` with `$,` set; say to a filehandle; companion io/say.t + op/print.t legs; a Pl/t guard row beside sep-vars-01.t. Runtime change -> sweep.

The :fh splitting is deduped into %p-out-target for all three list operators. Guard sep-vars-01.t row 5 (4 -> 5), inverse-verified on 76f5de7's runtime. ir-spec sec. 8.
